description: Tasdeeq Information Services Limited is a credit information bureau — the first to be licensed by the State Bank of Pakistan — which collects borrower data from member financial institutions and supplies credit reports and credit scores. Formerly Aequitas Information Services Limited, it was incorporated in 2016 and its shares trade on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its data repository, drawn from more than 110 member institutions, covers individuals, micro, small and medium enterprises, and corporates.
headOffice: 3rd Floor, FB1 Awami Complex, Usman Block, New Garden Town, Lahore
